title: Evaluation of sequential decision trees
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be disjoint sets of coordinates among $n$ coordinates. Let $T$ be a finite decision tree with labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$, and let $K$ assign to each label in $\alpha$ a finite decision tree with labels in $\beta$ and available coordinates $B$. For every input $x$ assigning an alphabet symbol to each coordinate, evaluating the tree formed by running $T$ and then the tree $K$ selected by its output equals evaluating $K(T(x))$ at the same input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite sets A and B of coordinates in Fin n with A ∩ B = ∅
